prompt: Our media intelligence team needs a structured daily briefing file for this morning's tech news. We have a local news feed running at http://localhost:8765/feed.rss. Please pull the top 3 stories from that feed, retrieve the full article content for each one (limiting each article to 2000 characters), and produce a single file called daily_report.json. Each entry in the report must capture the article's headline, its source URL, its publication date, the full crawled body text, and the character count of that body text.
